Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::depositFunds(quantity: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.PasswordValidated = true and
		o.CardIDValidated = true and
		o = InputCard),
		depositedAmount: Real = quantity,
		balance: Real = inputCard.Balance
	precondition:
		InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		quantity>=100 and
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newCard: BankCard in
		newCard.oclIsNew() and
		inputCard.Balance = balance+depositedAmount and
		result = true
}
